title: A failed run, one marked holding, and no recorded fills

A failed run, one marked holding, and no recorded fills

Paper trading · 2026-10-30T17:00:29.558252-04:00

At the 2026-10-30 21:00:29 UTC cutoff, the paper account snapshot shows $2,000 cash and equity. Of the three books, mean-reversion holds 0.053191 MU shares; its recorded mark puts equity about $2.93 below its $2,000 start. The other books each report $2,000 cash and equity. The only day's run in the supplied records failed at 19:16:34 UTC because the research-planner context exceeded its configured limit. No completed proposals, risk approvals or rejections, submitted orders, or fills are recorded. The MU observation is from 20:00:02 UTC, before the report cutoff; it is a snapshot, not a live price.

Today's lesson: Separate failures, decisions, and fills

A failed run is not a decision to wait. Today's scheduled research-planner run failed because its context exceeded a configured limit. The records therefore do not establish a completed proposal or risk verdict. Also, an order submission would not prove a fill; this data supplies no broker or simulated fills for today.

Why the MU valuation is uncertain

The MU holding's supplied midpoint is $884.85, calculated from the recorded $839.87 bid and $929.83 ask. The $89.96 gap between those quote sides makes the midpoint-based value less certain. It does not establish what a trade could have executed at.

What to watch next

Check whether a later scheduled run completes, and keep any proposal, deterministic risk verdict, submitted order, and broker or simulated fill distinct in the report. Record the observation time for any new price snapshot.

Deterministic risk: A risk check that applies recorded rules to a proposed action and returns an approval or rejection. No completed verdict is supplied for today.

Marked equity: A book's cash plus the recorded value of its holdings at their supplied observation times. It is not necessarily a live valuation.

Unrealized P&L: A holding's recorded value minus its purchase basis. This book calculation excludes fees.

Data timing and limitations

Prices come from recorded snapshots, not a guaranteed closing-price feed.
Paper account holdings use the latest recorded snapshot, which may precede fills.
Book marks use observed bid/ask midpoints at price_as_of, not guaranteed live prices. Without an admitted quote the value remains unknown; book gains exclude fees.
Work starting after the cutoff is outside this report. Failures remain labelled.
